title: Collection Activity While a Hardship or Protective Hold Runs — Matrix by Tier
content:
While a hold of **Hardship and Protective Holds** runs, collection activity on the held account changes according to the tier. The matrix records, tier by tier, which channels of collection stop, how credit reporting is treated and whether the consumer's own payments are accepted.

## Activity matrix

| Tier | Outbound collection calls stop | Collection letters stop | Collection emails and texts stop | No initial tradeline furnished | Tradeline treatment of a live tradeline | Consumer-initiated payments accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30-Day Hardship Pause | Yes | No | No | No | None | Yes |
| Documented Hardship Hold | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | None | Yes |
| Disaster Relief Hold | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Disaster special comment | Yes |
| Financial Assistance Review Hold | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | None | Yes |
| Long-Term Hardship Hold | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | None | Yes |
| Military Service Hold | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | None | Yes |

## Column definitions

- **Outbound collection calls stop** — whether outbound collection calls stop during the hold.
- **Collection letters stop** — whether collection letters stop during the hold.
- **Collection emails and texts stop** — whether collection emails and text messages stop during the hold.
- **No initial tradeline furnished** — whether an initial tradeline may not be furnished while the hold runs.
- **Tradeline treatment of a live tradeline** — the treatment of an account that already has a live tradeline when the hold starts: none, or the disaster special comment.
- **Consumer-initiated payments accepted** — whether payments the consumer initiates are accepted during the hold.

## Points of reading

- The 30-Day Hardship Pause stops outbound collection calls only; collection letters, emails and texts continue, and an initial tradeline is not suspended.
- Every other tier stops calls, letters, emails and texts and suspends the furnishing of an initial tradeline.
- The Disaster Relief Hold is the only tier whose live tradeline receives the disaster special comment.
- Every tier accepts payments the consumer initiates during the hold.
